## Core 4x4 Analytics Data Pipeline

A local Windows data application that converts marketplace and internal CSV exports into a standardized, traceable event ledger. The workflow separates source-specific parsing from shared validation, approved SKU mapping, duplicate handling, optional SQL Server loading, and Power BI analytics views.

## Life Expectancy Data Analysis

A menu-driven Python analysis of a structured global life-expectancy dataset. It summarizes overall extremes, filters records by year or country, calculates averages, and identifies the largest consecutive recorded decline within a country.

::: {.tag-list}

## CedHealth

A Flask-based health application for managing accounts, goals, meals, workouts, weight entries, favorites, and nutrition lookup. It uses SQLite persistence, Jinja templates, and progressive-web-app support.
